title: The Audrey phone messages
summary: Grant Cameron tells of The Audrey phone messages, about 2000s-2010s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: most people don't know there was 80 over 80 phone calls, Audrey phone calls to all sorts of people.

plain: Grant Cameron, a long-time researcher of UFO claims, says that over the 2000s and 2010s more than 80 phone calls came from a mysterious caller known as "Audrey" to all sorts of people in the United States. He names Stan Romanek, Paula Harris and Timothy Taylor among those connected to the story. If true, it would suggest some unknown intelligence was reaching out to people by telephone.
